Regarding
Annual guarantee of compliance for cultured dairy ingredients supplied under master agreement WCF-2219, covering cultured buttermilk concentrate, sour cream base and creme fraiche base.

Dear Supplier Compliance Team,

Willamette Cultured Foods, Inc. guarantees that all products sold and delivered to you are, at the time of delivery, not adulterated nor misbranded within the meaning of the Federal Food, Drug, and Cosmetic Act, and that each is manufactured in a facility operating a HACCP-based food safety plan under 21 CFR Part 117 with an SQF certified programme.

We further confirm that our ingredient suppliers are qualified annually, that no product supplied to you contains material derived from a facility subject to an active import alert, and that country-of-origin information is retained for every lot for a period of not less than two years from date of shipment.

This guarantee replaces the letter we issued to you in 2024 and, unless renewed or revoked in writing beforehand, it lapses on 03/31/2027. We will issue a replacement letter in advance of that date as part of our annual customer documentation cycle.

Yours sincerely,
